name: Fun in the Snow
source:
Entry for Winter VN Game Jam. Titania and Sima accepting loss and playing in the snow.

[From [url=https://noor-fernandez.itch.io/fun-in-the-snow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
冬季視覺小說創作活動的參賽作品。泰坦妮婭和西瑪學著接受失去，也一起在雪地裡玩耍。

（來源：[url=https://noor-fernandez.itch.io/fun-in-the-snow]itch.io[/url]）
